title: vue-legal-ml-builder
description: Vue 3 component library providing the user interface of the Legal Blocks / BAIGLE no-code machine learning workbench for legal text: dataset management and EDA, a guided model-creation wizard, training with live experiment monitoring, prediction and LIME/SHAP explanation views, visualization, and annotation, driven entirely through a host-supplied backend adapter (reference backend: legal-ml-core).
